convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for LaguerreFilter custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management, money management, and order execution logic

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before strategy activates

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: buy signal closes sell, sell signal closes buy

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode input selects between LOT (fixed lots) and RISK (deposit fraction); negative MM=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: Uses SignalBar=1 (previous bar) for signal evaluation. Entry signals computed on completed bar only (new bar guard via CIsNewBar). When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated every tick. BUY_Open and SELL_Open are gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen input booleans. BUY_Close and SELL_Close are gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are passed to position open functions for potential pending order logic. Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on CopyBuffer failure.
python_conversion_notes: Must implement LaguerreFilter custom indicator in Python (Laguerre RSI/filter with gamma parameter, two buffers: filter line and signal line). TradeAlgorithms.mqh position management functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_) need full reimplementation. The MarginMode enum (LOT vs RISK) controls position sizing logic. CIsNewBar class needs a Python equivalent for bar-level timing. Signal logic compares buffer1[1]>buffer0[1] (previous bar state) with buffer1[0]<buffer0[0] (current signal bar) for crossover detection.
